role: two additions to api_protocol.json: hosted models that can only state probabilities in text, on a fixed slice; and the two token-probability models on the context pilot
claim: Written before any of these runs touched a test item. A stated probability is a different object from a token probability or a one-pass typed distribution: the model writes numbers it chooses to write. It is reported as its own baseline and never pooled with the others.

budget.rule: as in api_protocol.json; spend continues in artifacts/api/spend.json

gemini-3.1-pro.added: 2026-10-11, before it saw any slice item: a strong reference with mandatory reasoning, on a seeded subset of the fixed slice (150 test and 50 dev items per dataset) because it costs about 25 times as much per item as the others

verbalized.reasoning_note: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite cannot run with reasoning off on this endpoint, so it runs at low effort and its generated tokens are reported. The other two run with reasoning off.

slice.rule: for each suite dataset, a seeded random subset of its test and dev items, drawn once and saved; the CLINC150 out-of-scope split is not included

readout: Take the first JSON object in the reply. Keys are read as option codes after stripping and zero-padding; keys that are not codes and values that are not non-negative numbers are dropped.
If the stated probabilities sum to more than 1 they are divided by their sum. If they sum to less than 1 the remainder is split equally among the options not listed.
The result is floored at 1e-9 and renormalised. Scores are its logarithm; one temperature per system and dataset is fit on the dev slice.
verbalized.unscorable: a reply with no usable JSON object is scored as uniform and counted
verbalized.also_reported: the mean number of options listed per reply and the mean stated sum

context_pilot.what: context_pilot_protocol.json conditions and items for Banking77 and CLINC150, unchanged; the wrapped text takes the place of the text in the api_protocol.json prompt; the top-k tree readout; each system keeps the temperature it has for the clean dataset on the suite
